description: This file defines a single exported function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of record objects, grouping and aggregating them based on specified dimensions ('environment' or 'cost_category') and outputting a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It ensures consistent categories across agents by zero-filling missing data points.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms a list of raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset for visualization, organizing data by agent and a secondary dimension while filling in missing categories with zeros for consistency.
